nn_med.name: truncated nearest-neighbor distance (median)
nn_med.formula: median( min_i ||p - q_i|| ), 仅保留 ||p-q|| <= trunc 的最近邻;截断后有效点 <100 则为 null
nn_med.unit: reference-frame length unit (plant_view: transforms.json 系,米)
nn_med.normalization: trunc = 0.05 * 参考云包围盒对角线 diag(逐序列打印)
nn_med.threshold: null (即几乎全部点超出 trunc) 视为该路径失败;无通过阈值,只作定性比较

nn_p90.name: truncated NN distance (P90)
nn_p90.formula: percentile_90 of the same truncated distances

n_beyond_trunc.name: points beyond truncation
n_beyond_trunc.normalization: 采样上限 80000 点(均匀步长下采样)
